Prayer times are calculated using the location (longitude, latitude) and a calculation method. The Calculation method is automatically chosen based on the country. Correct location detection requires either internet connection or and unblocked sky view. When needed, you can manually select the city and/or calculation method.
Your area might use some other calculation method and hence prayer times can differ. Please always verify with your area’s prayer times and keep us informed for any differences.

Zohr time indicates when the sun reaches its highest point. Avoid praying for roughly five minutes before and five minutes after that moment. When using the “Presidency of Religious Affairs, Turkey” calculation method, or any timing source marked with a verification tick, this buffer period is already included.
